        	<h2>Brief Biography</h2>
          	<p> 
          	I am a Professor and Chair of <a href="https://stat.snu.ac.kr/en/">the Department of Statistics</a> at <a href="http://en.snu.ac.kr/">Seoul National University</a> and the founding director of the <a href="http://idis.snu.ac.kr/">Institute for Data Innovation in Science (IDIS)</a>. Before joining SNU, I spent seven years at the University of Pittsburgh, following my Ph.D. at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. </p>
          	
          		<p>My research focuses on statistical theory and methods for non-Euclidean and high-dimensional data, with particular emphasis on the interplay between geometry and statistics. I study estimation, dimension reduction, and inference for data on manifolds and metric spaces, alongside high-dimensional classification and the integration of data from multiple sources. Recent interests include robust statistical methods, reliable prediction, and the statistical foundations of AI. Through interdisciplinary collaborations, I also work on AI for science, connecting statistical methodology with scientific questions and complex scientific data. Another strand of my research concerns data privacy, including differential privacy, synthetic data, and the assessment of their statistical utility and disclosure risks. Across these areas, I aim to develop methods that combine theoretical understanding with practical value for data analysis. </p>
 
<p> I have authored two books and coauthored one more, all in Korean:

### Recent News [(More news)](news.html)

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE, comment=FALSE}
a = readLines("newslist.Rmd", n = -1)
n = length(a)
nullid = rep(1,n)
for(i in 1:n){if(identical("", a[i])){nullid[i] = 0}}
a = a[nullid == TRUE] 
n = length(a)
k = n
for(i in 1:n){if(identical("# BadNews", a[i])){k = i;break;}}
k = min(n,5)
for (i in 2:(k-1)) { 
  cat(paste(" - ", sep = "", a[i]))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
